_readme: Every line of character copy on the site and in Discord lives here.
Edit this file and restart the bot; no code changes needed.
goal_reactions / board / rep: lists of {at, text}. 'at' is the lowest value
the line applies to, and the highest matching band wins. Keep them sorted
ascending. goal_reactions are keyed on funding percent, board on the number
of ranked members, rep on InoRep total.
footer_quips / thank_you: {key, text} where key is riko, ino or yura.
site: one-off strings used in page copy and emails.

site.goal_blurb: Hit the target and Rayen puts on the maid outfit.
site.goal_stinger: one costume. that's the whole prize.
site.terms_body: The deal is simple. The bar hits a hundred percent and Rayen puts on the maid outfit. That is the whole prize.
site.how_goal: When the bar fills, Rayen puts on the maid outfit. Hitting the goal is the costume — a target he can hit, not a stream.
site.terms_note: Every donation counts toward the total the moment Ko-fi confirms it. Tick the private box on Ko-fi and only the number moves, your name stays off this page.
site.kofi_notice: Haven't linked your Discord account before buying? Please contact Seika, either in DMs or in the Ask and Complain to Staff channel.
site.hero_title: Every picture posted here gets a verdict.
site.hero_lede: Ino tracks every image in the server, counts the votes, and keeps the running order. No favourites, no appeals.
site.board_lede: Scores come from reactions on images posted in the art channels. One point per net upvote, counted the moment someone reacts.
site.footer_blurb: Every image posted in the Just Rayen server gets scored, ranked and remembered. This is where the tally lives.

bios.ino: Runs this place and keeps every record in it. Your InoRep is hers, and she remembers exactly how kind you have been.
bios.riko: Scores the art and will not admit she cares about any of it. Do not mention the blushing.
bios.yura: Very fond of Rayen. Very patient. Would love to pay you a visit if the goal stalls.

riko.text: Zero. Not one of you. I-I'm not disappointed or anything, dummy. I just assumed at least ONE person had taste. My mistake.
One person. ONE. I wrote their name down somewhere nice. The rest of you are also written down, just... somewhere else.
A quarter already? O-Oh. Huh. That's not completely pathetic. Don't let it go to your heads.
Halfway?! W-Well obviously I knew you'd get here. I never doubted it. Not even once. Stop looking at me like that!
Three quarters and Rayen has gone very, very quiet. I-It's not like I'm enjoying watching him panic. ...Okay. Maybe a little.
You're THIS close and you're just standing there?! Somebody finish it! My cooling fans are just loud, shut up!
It's done. He actually has to wear it. ...Thank you. A-And if you tell anyone I said that, I'll deny it. Idiot.

ino.text: The offering box is empty for now. That's alright. Everything starts empty, and I'm very patient.
Someone came by. I've written their name in the book properly, with the date and everything.
A quarter of the way. I light a lantern for every donation, and the shrine is starting to look rather lovely.
Halfway. I've stopped counting the lanterns and started counting the people. There are more of you than I expected.
Three quarters. Rayen asked me twice today whether this is legally binding. I told him it was. It isn't. He seems convinced.
Very nearly there. I've already pressed the costume, which I admit may have been presumptuous of me.
It's complete. Every name is recorded and none of them will be forgotten. Thank you, truly. Go and rest now.

yura.text: Nobody has donated yet. That's fine. I have all your addresses written down and absolutely nothing else on today.
One of you understands. Only one. I'd like to visit the rest of you and explain, in person, at length, tonight.
A quarter. I've been outside Rayen's house six hours making sure he doesn't leave before this finishes. He waved. I think he waved.
Halfway. I'm being patient. I'm very good at being patient. I've been patient outside your window for a while now, actually.
So close. If this doesn't finish tonight I'll simply come round and help you decide. I'll bring snacks. I know which ones you like.
One more. One. If you make me come over there I won't be cross, I'll just be very close to you for a very long time.
He's wearing it. He's finally wearing it. I don't need to visit any of you now. ...Probably. Sleep well!

board.text: Nobody's posted anything. An empty board. Do you know how embarrassing that is for me? Post something, dummy.
One whole person on the board. Congratulations, you're winning by default. Don't get comfortable.
Look at all of you fighting over internet points. It's pathetic. I check it every hour. That's different.
Over a hundred of you on here now. I remember when this was three people and a picture of a cat. I-I'm not getting sentimental, shut up.
Do you have any idea how much counting this is? I do it perfectly every time, obviously, but a thank you wouldn't kill you.

rep.text: I would like to say something kind here and I am struggling. Please be nicer. I'll wait.
You and I have had a difficult time of it. The book is honest, but pages can be added. Start today.
A small negative mark. Barely anything. I'd rather not write any more of them, if it's all the same to you.
A blank page. That isn't a bad thing. Most good stories start on one.
You've been kind, and I've noticed. I notice everything, it's rather the point of me.
You've been good to this place for a long time now. The shrine knows your footsteps.
I keep a separate page for people like you. It is not a long list.
There is very little left for me to write about you that isn't simply gratitude. Thank you for staying.

footer_quips.text: You made it all the way down. I keep the small print tidy for exactly this sort of person.
Nothing important down here. Go and be kind to someone, it does show up in your record.
Congratulations, you found the small text. That's the whole prize.
Still reading? I-It's not like I put effort into this or anything.
You read all of it. Every word. I like that about you. I like a lot of things about you.
There's nothing else down here. I checked. I check every night, around three.

thank_you.text: I've written **{name}** into the book for **{amount}**. Properly, in ink.
**{name}** gave **{amount}**. That's a lantern lit and a name recorded.
**{name}** donated **{amount}**. I'm not impressed. ...Fine. A little impressed.
**{name}** just put in **{amount}**. Th-thanks. Don't make it weird.
**{name}** gave **{amount}**. I'll remember that. I remember everything about the kind ones.
**{amount}** from **{name}**. You've been added to the list. The nice list.

404.title: There's nothing here.
404.blurb: Whatever you were looking for either moved, never existed, or you typed it wrong.
404.riko: Nope. Nothing here. Did you type it yourself? With your own hands? Wow.
404.ino: This page isn't in the records, and I would know. I keep them.
404.yura: I checked everywhere for you. Twice. I do that anyway, but this time it was for you.

500.title: Something broke.
500.blurb: That one is on us, not you. It has been logged and someone will be blamed shortly.
500.riko: It broke. Not my fault. Probably Rayen's. Definitely Rayen's, actually.
500.ino: Something has gone wrong behind the scenes. I'm tidying it up now.
500.yura: Don't worry about it. I'll find out which server did this and have a word.

email.subject: Thank you for supporting Ino
email.heading: Thank you.
email.intro: Your donation of {amount} has been recorded against the current goal.
email.signoff: Ino, on behalf of everyone who did not want to write this email themselves.
email.ino_note: I've written your name in the book. Properly, in ink. It stays there.
email.riko_note: Th-thanks. I'm not going to make a whole thing out of it. Don't expect a card.
email.yura_note: You're on the nice list now. I don't need to visit. Probably.
